_comment: The map base: a hole in hell's ground, one ring deck round the void the tower stands in, with a lava river cut into it. Authored in WORLD coordinates -- instance at identity: deck at y=23.0 (r 46.7..57.3) under a rock ceiling at y=31.5 (the gallery is a cutout, open toward the void), lava sea at y=-11.05, rim at y=330. The river is NOT a sheet laid on anything: between bearings 292.3 and 338.3 the deck's own surface is dropped 0.3 m to y=22.7 between two sloped banks, and those faces take the Lava material. The channel carries on into both walls the same way -- cut 0.4 m back into the shaft wall from 293 to 338 deg, y 22.7 up to 30.7, and 0.4 m back into the pit wall all the way down to the sea -- so the lava is always map_base's own faces, defined by banks, never an overlay. Over 296..334 deg the shaft wall is UNDERCUT: a cave mouth 2.5 m back into the rock from y 22.7 to a ragged lip near y 26.3, the bed carried in under it. The bed is faceted (+-0.15 m plates) with crust plates; the banks are a 0.3 m lip in three facets whose line wanders +-0.4 m station to station, with boulders standing on it. Seven platforms with flat square 2.4 x 2.4 m tops at y=23.0 stand 0.3 m out of it; three fins rise off the inner ones. Prison cells (arched glowing recesses with carved columns) are carved into the pit faces, visual only, and none in the channel. TWO surfaces: the hell-rock atlas (rock + emissive), and Lava -- ONE 256 px ULTRAKILL-Prelude sheet (orange, yellow-white veins, near-black crust, hard pixel edges, molten texels emissive) shared by the pit floor, the channel bed and both wall runs at 6 m per repeat, random window and rotation per facet. All single-sided. MapBaseCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node (deck minus the channel, a flat surface at the lava height minus the platform footprints, the platform tops and sides, the fins, pit wall, courtyard disc, outer wall, flat ceiling); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn.
